story.body: You let the rail keep its morning, and you went in to the speech.

title: Looked at the frost on the yard rail

participation.context: Called the lines very good, answered the question about the lady, and stopped the book from deciding.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Spoke the lines exactly, cracked on the call, and finished lower.
participation.name: Nick Sorrell

participation.context: Offered mornings from the door, and refused a cure he had not promised.
participation.name: Augustine Phillips

participation.context: Stayed on the hamper, studied his nails, and did not take the part.
participation.name: Arthur Meeks

participation.context: Asked after the book, was told to leave the sheet, and cut nothing.
participation.name: Abel Garnish

relations.note: the voice can be nursed and not mended
relations.quote: It can be nursed. It can't be mended.

story.body: You let Nick give the speech as written, you heard the call fail, and you left the sheet uncut. The refusal itself you did not speak in the room.

title: Heard Nick's voice crack on the call
